[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r1] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | With prefixed hamza, the perfect follows أفعل and the imperfect follows يفعل; this pattern applies across augmented verbs, with forms like أخرج and يخرج.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r10] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | No verb takes a prefixed connected hamza as an addition except أفعل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r11] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | An added second radical alif forms فاعل in the perfect and يفاعل in the imperfect, with corresponding patterns for other prefixes.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r12] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The pattern is illustrated by قاتل يقاتل and its related prefixed imperfect forms.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r13] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Agent and patient nouns from this pattern parallel those from Afʿala if fully formed, despite the different placement of the added alif; examples are قوتل and مقاتل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r14] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Nouns from augmented verbs are generally adjectives, except forms on مفعل, which can be lexical nouns such as مخدع.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r15] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The second-radical alif occurs in verbs only in the فاعل pattern.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r16] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | An addition at the middle radical produces the فعّل pattern, which follows فاعل across its conjugations, as in جرب يجرب.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r17] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | The imperfect forms with yāʾ, tāʾ, nūn, and hamza follow the same vowel pattern; differing prefixes distinguish their meanings.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r18] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | These patterns resemble unaugmented quadriliteral verbs such as دحرج in their number of radicals and vowel pattern, which accounts for the prefix vowel and noun formation.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r19] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | A prefixed t with فاعل gives تفاعل and يتفاعل; its passive perfect is تفوعل, and its agent and patient nouns use متفاعل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r2] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Every أفعل follows this pattern as a four-radical verb, whether otherwise augmented or unaugmented; examples include يخرج، تخرج، أخرج, and نخرج.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r20] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | In augmented active and passive participles, the difference is the vowel before the final letter; their initial mīm is always dammated.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r21] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | A prefixed t with فعّل follows تفاعل across its inflections, except that its third radical occupies the position corresponding to the long alif.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r22] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Only تفاعل and تفعل have both an initial t and a third radical addition; تفعل is not given the same prefix vowels because it patterns with quadriliteral تدحرج and has the meaning of انفعل.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r3] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · الخليل | reports | Khalil says the expected analogy would retain hamza in the imperfect and related forms, as t is retained in تفعلت and تفاعلت.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r4] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Speakers instead regularly delete the hamza in this imperfect pattern because it is heavy and frequent.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r5] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Deletion is especially apt because the hamza is an added letter attached to an already augmented form, is heavy, and has a replacement when lost.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r6] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · خطام المجاشعي | reports | Rajaz poet Khaṭṭām al-Mujāshiʿī retains the hamza under poetic necessity in وصاليات ككما يؤثفين, from أثفيت.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r7] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · ليلى الأخيلية | reports | Laylā al-Akhyaliyya likewise retains the hamza under poetic necessity in كرات غلام من كساء مؤرنب.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابلحاقالزيادةبناتالثلاثةمنالفعل)#754/r8] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | For augmented verbs, the agent noun parallels أفعل with mīm replacing initial alif; the object noun follows the imperfect pattern, as in مضروب.
